title: Agentic mandate (JWT claims set)
description: Claims carried in an EdDSA-signed JWT (typ: mandate+jwt). Documentation only: the gateway reads the `required` claims and ignores the rest.

iss.description: Issuer URL. Must resolve in the trust registry.

cnf.description: Proof-of-possession key of the delegate (RFC 7800). The agent signs each request with this key.

agent_id.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of cnf.jwk, or any stable id

server.description: MCP server name as exposed by the gateway

constraints.description: Argument constraints: each key must appear in tool arguments with a value in the given list. A `path` value is cleaned before it is compared and forwarded (./a and a//b both mean a); one with .., a leading / or anything a server could read as another file is refused with PATH_NOT_ALLOWED

max_rows.description: Most rows one call under this entry may ask for, for tools that take a `limit` (pupil-data.search, pupil-data.get). It can only lower the gateway's own limit of 100, which a call that leaves `limit` out gets. A `limit` above it, or a left-out one when it is below 100, is refused with LIMIT_EXCEEDED; a value that is not a whole number of at least 1 with CLAIM_NOT_UNDERSTOOD

deny.description: Glob patterns over 'server.tool'; deny always wins over scope

clearance.description: The most sensitive data it may see, on the manifest's scale. Absent means 3: never special category

purpose_code.description: The job it is for, from PURPOSES in gateway/lib/policy.py. Limits the tools and caps the clearance

budget.description: Different pupils the whole job may see, helpers included. Absent means 50

may_delegate.description: 1 if the agent may hand part of this on to helpers

helpers.description: Revocation numbers set aside for helpers; a helper must use one

shown.description: Hash of the words the person was shown before signing
